rssMiB.note: docker stats MemUsage of lettuce-perf-app (mem_limit 512 MiB); idle = after a 2-iteration every-persona reviews-team-view warm-up on a freshly restored app, two samples 4 s apart; peak = max of ~23 samples every 4 s during reviews-team-view mixed 50 VUs 2m (closed loop)

app.retentionPins: ACTIVITY_ACCOUNT_RETENTION_DAYS=0, NOTIFICATION_RETENTION_DAYS=0 (the real-clock purges are off on the perf stack)

postgres.observerOverheadNote: auto_explain.log_analyze=on instruments EVERY statement (row counting + buffer usage; per-node timing is off via log_timing=off) and pg_stat_statements + track_io_timing add a little per call, so absolute database milliseconds are inflated slightly; statement and transaction counts are exact and unaffected. No statement of any window exceeded 50 ms (max_exec 7.2 ms), so every auto_explain file was empty (not committed).

scenario.web: perf/run.sh web org-chart | pulse-results --persona hr | activity-log --persona ceo (5 measured iterations + a cold run each, 1x CPU) -> web/*.json (waterfalls dropped); compare with 2026-10-04-3076bbd4/web
scenario.report: report-vs-2026-10-04-acd9d3ed.md = perf/run.sh report v4140 --baseline perf/baselines/2026-10-04-acd9d3ed (no RUN NOT CLEAN; the only count increases are +1 statement on GET /teams — the new memberIds grouped query, by design — incl. every shell-probe)
scenario.knownNotClean: none: 0 failed requests and 0 responses without Server-Timing in every run
scenario.summaries: reduced to the metrics scripts/perf_compare.py reads; no tokens (the JWT-prefix grep is empty)

caveat: OrbStack on one laptop is not production: compare milliseconds relatively, statement/transaction counts exactly. Baselines compare only within one datasetVersion.
